binaries.name: memprocfs
binaries.why: Mount a memory image as a file system: processes, handles, modules, registry and network state become files the ordinary tools read. AGPL-3.0, so its licence and this project's combine where Volatility's do not.

binaries.name: vol
binaries.why: The plugin framework most reports cite. Not shipped here and not wrapped: the Volatility Software License and AGPL-3.0 do not combine in one work, so it is invoked as an executable or not at all.

binaries.name: avml
binaries.why: Acquire memory from a live Linux host into a portable format, without building a kernel module.

binaries.name: strings
binaries.why: A first pass over a region before a parser is chosen. Always search UTF-16LE as well, which strings -el does.
